items.followUp: How is natural gas formed from the remains of organisms?

rubric.why: Biogas is produced when anaerobic bacteria decompose biomass without oxygen.
rubric.description: Explains that bacteria decompose biomass in the absence of oxygen.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing the preparation process.

rubric.why: Methane is the main combustible component of biogas.
rubric.description: Identifies methane as the main combustible component.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming methane and its role in biogas.

modelAnswer: Biogas is prepared by placing biomass in a digester and allowing anaerobic bacteria to decompose it in the absence of oxygen.
Biogas contains methane as its main combustible component.

items.followUp: Define a moment of force and state its formula.

rubric.why: A rigid body is treated as having an unchanging shape and size when forces act on it.
rubric.description: Defines a rigid body by its unchanging shape and size.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating the defining property of a rigid body.

rubric.why: The axis of rotation is the line about which a body turns.
rubric.description: Defines the axis of rotation as the line around which a body rotates.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the axis of rotation correctly.

modelAnswer: A rigid body is an ideal body whose shape and size remain unchanged when forces act on it.
The axis of rotation is the imaginary straight line about which a body rotates.
